title: MoreDanger
body:
**Alpha Notice:** _Even though this says alpha -- it is geared towards features and feature tweaks. 

From our testing the mob is stable and we have not had any crashes associated with it. Performance has been excellent as well._

==========

MoreDanger is a lightweight difficulty enhancer for Minecraft that lets you crank up the chaos with three escalating modes: Hard, Nightmare, and Hell. Mobs get tougher, faster, and meaner — and they might even curse you with nasty effects when they land a hit! (Nightmare and Hell modes only)

**Features**

    Dynamic Mob Buffs: Monsters scale their health, speed, damage, armor, and more based on the active mode.

    Status Effect Attacks: In Nightmare and Hell modes, mobs have a chance to inflict debuffs like Poison, Wither, Blindness, or Nausea when they attack players.

    Mode-Based Follow Range: Mobs can detect and chase players from farther away in higher modes.

    Simple Config System: All settings are saved to a JSON file and reload automatically. In creative or with cheats on convenient mode commands as well (see below if interested.)

    No Bloat: No mob coordination, no performance drag — just pure difficulty.

Commands

Use /moredanger mode <level> to switch difficulty on the fly:
(should require cheats or creative)

    /moredanger mode normal
    /moredanger mode hard
    /moredanger mode nightmare
    /moredanger mode hell
